stories.title: copier/update: managed writes replace symlinks and re-record 120000 entries
stories.description: Closes #357 (write path). copyFile lstat-unlinks a symlinked destination; callers pass the set of index-tracked symlinks collected once per run; a 120000 entry is rewritten and re-recorded as 100644; conversions are reported in the update summary.
stories.testEvidence: test/copier-symlinks.test.ts (index-120000 shape, junction and POSIX link shapes, the no-conversion case) and test/update-issue-wave-2026-10-20.test.ts AC-357-3: red before the edit (missing exports; the shim fell into the 'Kept customized' branch), green after. Full suite 2350 passed, 0 failed after the review fixes; copier.ts 99.0% lines, 100% branches (2026-10-20).

stories.title: doctor: flag managed paths tracked as symlinks and shims whose body is a path
stories.description: Closes #357 (doctor half). checkManagedFileModes fails naming each 120000-tracked managed path and each client shim whose whole body is a single relative path, with the fix; skipped outside a git repository or without a manifest.
stories.testEvidence: test/doctor-managed-file-modes.test.ts, 6 tests: red before the edit (checkManagedFileModes missing), green after. Full suite green (2026-10-20).

stories.title: update --prune: git-verified fallback for orphans with no recorded hash
stories.description: Closes #358. resolveOrphan prunes a hash-less orphan only when git shows it tracked, clean and touched by exactly one commit; otherwise reports it with the manual route (git rm, then drop the component from .arcane.json). The retired component's entry is dropped once every file is gone.
stories.testEvidence: test/update-prune-fallback.test.ts (11 tests against real git fixtures) and AC-358-4 in test/update-issue-wave-2026-10-20.test.ts: red before the edit (isUneditedTrackedFile missing; the retained entry still listed pruned files), green after. Full suite green (2026-10-20).

stories.title: update: refuse without the user tier; routing block tells agents to stop
stories.description: Closes #359. A spell_scope user repository whose machine has no readable ~/.arcane manifest makes spell update exit 1 before any write, dry-run included; renderSpellRoutingSection appends the stop rule when spellScope is user.
stories.testEvidence: test/agent-generator-routing.test.ts (red: renderSpellRoutingSection not exported) and test/update-issue-wave-2026-10-20.test.ts AC-359-1 (refusal in a real run and a dry run; proceeds once the tier exists); missingTierWarning's five existing tests unchanged. Full suite green (2026-10-20).
